hints.content: To find the zeros of the function, we need to solve the equation $g(t)=0$. We can do that by factoring $g(t)$.
There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $t$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }t&=-6
\\\\
\text{larger }t&=7
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(\dfrac{1}{2},-\dfrac{169}{4}\right)$
